title: Promo stacking cap for foodora
already_ships: Foodora has a manual promo cap and a weekly ops review. Last year showed 8% stacked-promo abuse and about €1.8M loss on the promo journey.

options.title: Keep the weekly review
options.summary: Leave the manual promo cap and weekly ops review unchanged for this quarter.

options.title: Hard stack cap
options.summary: Ship a hard cap of one paid promo per checkout and measure stack rate before widening.

devils_advocate.why_fails: A hard cap will block legitimate multi-voucher campaigns and spike support tickets in week one.
devils_advocate.who_loses: Growth and brand-PnL teams that rely on stacked acquisition codes in DE and AT.
devils_advocate.cannot_measure: True displacement of stacking rings will not show in ninety days of one brand.
devils_advocate.why_not_live_control: The weekly review already catches the loudest stacks after the order is placed.

recommendation.argument: The locked outcome is a Finance-grade cut in stack rate; only a hard cap produces a measurable 90-day proof.
